correctness.rationale: For degree d=q+1, any proper coloring with a color-dominating vertex has at most d+1=q+2 colors. Complete finite certificate arrays for q=3 and q=4 were checked over every field triple, all 26/42 vertices, 52/105 edges and every vertex neighborhood. They are proper and give precisely two dominating vertices of each of q+2 colors. The standalone standard-library verifier reproduces its output exactly. No unverified infinite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: These are both minimal-order (q+1)-regular girth-six incidence configurations at the first two noncubic degrees q+1=4 and 5 of an explicitly posed conjecture.
